== Acquisition ==
Part of [[Togo (disguise)|Togo's]] replacement [[skill bar]] during [[The Tengu Accords]] mission.

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Disenchantment}}

== Notes ==
* This skill is normally used with 11 in [[Communing]] (its spirit's level differs from [[Disenchantment]]), but the attribute rank can be affected by [[Weakness]] and a [[Staff Wrapping]] [[Of Attribute|of Communing]].
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Disenchantment]] that uses the [[Disenchantment (attack)|Disenchantment attack skill]].
* Like other spirits, this does not preferentially [[target]] [[foe]]s against which its effect would be useful (in this case, enchanted foes).
